vocabulary_gaps: No 1-Wire protocol or builder. DQ is modelled as a digital leaf with role bidirectional and capabilities onewire_dq and open_drain, so it pairs with an MCU GPIO; the protocol, ROM code and timing are in traits. A onewire protocol (master/slave, multidrop, pull-up rule like bus_pullup) would let DRC check the pull-up and parasite power.

No protocol for a cylindrical surface sealed by an O-ring (rod seal) or a cable gland. Modelled as mechanical `custom` (peer) with capability rod_seal_surface and tube_diameter / tube_length parameters, as the spring bar and fastener parts do for their joints.
